newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains down on strong sterling.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains down on strong sterling.

text.p: LIFFE grains eased in subdued trade on sterling's strength against the mark, traders said.
On wheat November dominated, with 252 lots of a total 479. It last traded 1.55 stg lower at 92.40 stg.
November was also most active on barley, with 45 of a total 61 lots. It last traded 1.25 stg lower at 90.00 stg.
Volume was kept down by a holiday in many European countries, traders said. One noted that a high proportion of the volume done was in the final stages of trading.
Sterling was over two pfennigs higher in late European trading, boosted by a robust dollar and better than expected UK public debt.
